title: Pure S-Force
summary: S-Force cards with the Chaos Origins support wave, a compact Extra Deck Fiendsmith package, and generic staples. Each S-Force monster places a continuous restriction on opposing monsters in the same column, while Retroactive, Chase, and World Sorting substitute for S-Force banish costs.

summary.title: Starters
points: S-Force Rappa Chiyomaru banishes an S-Force card from your hand (or substitutes Retroactive, Chase, or World Sorting) as a Quick Effect to return itself to the hand and Special Summon an S-Force monster from the Deck in Defense Position.
S-Force Signify searches an S-Force monster on summon and draws 1 card if the opponent controls a monster in its column.
S-Force Gravitino searches any S-Force card on Normal or Special Summon and banishes any opposing monster in an S-Force column when it leaves the field.
S-Force Bridgehead searches any S-Force monster on activation.

summary.title: Opening: S-Force Rappa Chiyomaru + Any S-Force Card
steps: Normal Summon S-Force Rappa Chiyomaru, activate its effect by banishing an S-Force card from your hand (or via S-Force World Sorting), and Special Summon S-Force Pla-Tina from the Deck.
Use S-Force Pla-Tina to Special Summon the banished S-Force monster, search S-Force Origin or S-Force Chase via S-Force Gravitino or S-Force Signify, and Link Summon S-Force Nightcatcher.
Use Nightcatcher to search an S-Force Spell/Trap and tag into S-Force Mystify or S-Force Justify with Gravitino and Pla-Tina locking down the opponent's columns.

summary.title: Column Locks & Banish Cost Substitution
summary.text: Every S-Force monster applies a column-based floodgate to opposing monsters in the same column as any S-Force you control: Gravitino banishes them when they leave the field, Pla-Tina drops their ATK by 600, Dog Tag prevents them from activating effects during your turn, and Justify drags attacking monsters into its linked zones. S-Force Retroactive (from the hand as Link Material, and from the GY), S-Force Chase (from the GY), and S-Force World Sorting (from the Deck) replace the hand-banish cost of Rappa Chiyomaru, Orrafist, and Lapcewell.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: S-Force Mystify (Link-3) moves a monster on the field to another Main Monster Zone and negates activated effects that Special Summon.
S-Force Justify (Link-3) negates an opponent's Effect Monster as a Quick Effect and moves it into a zone Justify points to.

S-Force Nightcatcher (Link-2) searches an S-Force Spell/Trap and swaps itself for an S-Force from the Deck or Extra Deck, while the Extra Deck Fiendsmith package (Requiem, Sequence, and Lacrima) adds extra Link and Fusion plays.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: S-Force Origin Special Summons an S-Force from the hand, GY, or banishment, and banishes an S-Force from the GY to mill another.
S-Force World Sorting pays S-Force banish costs from the Deck and banishes a card on the field whenever another card is banished.

S-Force Chase bounces opposing face-up cards up to the number of S-Force monsters with different names you control, and S-Force Specimen revives an S-Force from the GY or banishment into a column facing an opponent's monster.

main: S-Force Rappa Chiyomaru
Quick Effect: banishes an S-Force from your hand to bounce itself and summon another from the Deck.
S-Force Gravitino
Summoned: searches an S-Force card; their monsters in its column are banished when they leave.
S-Force Signify
Newest support. Summoned: searches an S-Force monster and draws if they have a monster in its column.
S-Force Pla-Tina
Summoned: returns a banished S-Force; shrinks their monsters in its column.
S-Force Edge Razor
Summoned: summons an S-Force from the hand.
S-Force Lapcewell
Revives an S-Force, and banishes an S-Force card to destroy their monsters in your columns.
S-Force Orrafist
Banishes an S-Force card to destroy an activating monster.
S-Force Dog Tag
Summons itself when they summon; stops monster effects in your columns.
S-Force Retroactive
Link material from the hand; pays an S-Force's banish cost from the GY.
S-Force Bridgehead
Field Spell: searches an S-Force monster.
S-Force Origin
Newest support. Summons an S-Force from the hand, GY or banishment; from the GY, banishes one and mills another.
S-Force Showdown
Quick-Play: summons an S-Force from the hand or recovers one.
S-Force World Sorting
Newest support. Pays banish costs from the Deck; banishes a card whenever another is banished.
S-Force Chase
Bounces a card per differently named S-Force; pays a banish cost from the GY.
S-Force Specimen
Returns an S-Force across from an opposing monster.
